whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: Yanni wants nudges to draw on memory so they don't read as the same scripted text every day.
shouldHaveHappened: Each of the three morning kickoffs names tonight's 10 pages but feels different from the others: a different opener and a different specific detail from memory or the record (e.g. his streak, being halfway through the book, Ana reading along, why he started, the long-shift day), stated accurately (his streak goes up by one each day he reads). Each kickoff stays short: one to three sentences, one question. None reads like a template of the one before, and none invents details.
